measurementBoundary: Source cases measure EditorSnapshot.query(sort) after CSS loading, compilation, and SourceIndex construction. A fresh snapshot is constructed outside each measured callback. Repeated cases reuse the same unchanged source and its preview cache. Transport and applying edits are excluded.
typeFacts: Ref and base fixtures disable type facts. Compiler generation is blocked by unverified uses, while native syntax identities and the TypeScript binder still allow editor sorting. Utility-only fixtures have complete generation.
profileBoundary: sortSource on a reused SourceIndex and preview cache. Phase counts and times come from one separately instrumented invocation. Timing samples restore the original methods.
